rows.en:
(Geez, that Hoshimura... She said we'd run
the P.E. marathon together, then took off
like a bat out of hell right at the start...)

(...Huh? Wait,
is that Hoshimura wiped out over there?)

Hah, hah, hah...
Hey, \p.
Long time no see......

Long time no see, my foot.
You're the one who ditched me out of nowhere...

Sorry, sorry!
I just wanted to be in first place,
even if it was only for a second...
(Hoshimura really never thinks ahead.)

I wanted to make it with you, but it looks
like this is as far as I go......
Never mind me... go on ahead!
Okay, if you say so. I'll go on ahead, then.

Whaaat~! That's so mean~!
Leaving a delicate maiden behind?!
You fiend~! You devil~!!
"Devil"...?

(Haah~, it can't be helped...
Guess I'll head for the finish line with Hoshimura.)

(Geez, Yui... She said we'd run
the P.E. marathon together, then just
dashed off right at the start...)

(...Huh? Wait,
is that Yui wiped out over there?)

Long time no see, my foot.
You're the one who ditched me out of nowhere...
(Yui really never thinks ahead.)
Okay, if you say so. I'll go on ahead, then.

(Haah~, it can't be helped...
Maybe I'll head for the finish line with Yui.)

(Deep Akihabara has all kinds of shops,
so just wandering around like this is fun.)
Oh-ho? If it isn't \p!

Oh, Hoshimura.
Did you come to Deep Akihabara to shop?

Yup. I caught wind of a rumor that junk parts
are going dirt cheap, so I hurried right over.

Junk parts...? Is it really okay
to buy stuff like that?

Tsk, tsk, tsk. You just don't get it.
Sometimes stuff is good precisely
because it's junk.

That's riiight!
So with that, I'm gonna pop over there
real quick!
(Hoshimura really loves machines.)

(Deep Akihabara has all kinds of shops,
so just wandering around like this is fun.)

Oh, Yui.
Did you come to Deep Akihabara to shop?

Junk parts...? Is it really okay
to buy stuff like that?
(Yui really loves machines.)
(Pool class on a hot day really is the best.)

Ahhh... A pool on a hot day like this
is sheer paradise, I tell ya~

...You kinda sound like a middle-aged lady,
Hoshimura.

Hmph! You'd call a fresh young thing
like Yui-san a middle-aged lady?!
What is the meaning of this!!

Here, look!
Feast your eyes on this sexy body of mine!!

(Hmmm......
I wouldn't exactly call it sexy...)

(Going by size alone, she's no match
for Nanase or Akimizu...)

...Hey, you're thinking something rude
right now, aren't you?
...I think you're imagining things.
(Hoshimura's sharp in the weirdest places.)
(Pool class on a hot day really is the best.)
...You kinda sound like a middle-aged lady, Yui.

(Hmmm......
I wouldn't exactly call it sexy...)

(Going by size alone, she's no match
for Nanase or Yuu...)
...I think you're imagining things.
(Yui's sharp in the weirdest places.)

(Geez, that Hoshimura... Sleeping through
that whole class from start to finish. That takes
guts, or... I don't even know what to call it...)
Hey, Hoshimura, wake up. Hellooo?
Five... more...... hours.........

Five more hours and school will be over!
Hoshimura, I said wake up!

I can't eat that much steak, I tell ya...
Mmm... mumble mumble...

(She's obviously talking in her sleep.
Oh well, there's nothing else for it...)

Next class is EX-Gear maintenance,
but I take it you're staying here asleep
in the classroom, Hoshimura?

What?! Is our next class
EX-Gear maintenance?!

I can't be dawdling like this!
I must make haste!!
(And Hoshimura's already gone...)

(After she wouldn't even get up
a minute ago... Honestly...)

(Geez, Yui... Sleeping through
that whole class from start to finish. That takes
guts, or... I don't even know what to call it...)
Hey, Yui, wake up. Hellooo?

Five more hours and school will be over!
Yui, I said wake up!

(She's obviously talking in her sleep.
Oh well, there's nothing else for it...)

Next class is EX-Gear maintenance,
but I take it you're staying here asleep
in the classroom, Yui?
(And Yui's already gone...)

(After she wouldn't even get up
a minute ago... Honestly, geez...)
